title: Correct final expression
description: Essential: The answer must be in the form Δt = √[2(h+b)/g] − √[2h/g] or an equivalent simplified form.

title: Free-fall to point C
description: Important: Applies the kinematic equation h = (1/2)gt₁² to find the time for end B to reach the top of the cylinder.

title: Free-fall to point D
description: Important: Applies the kinematic equation h+b = (1/2)gt₂² to find the time for end B to reach the bottom of the cylinder.

title: Time difference interpretation
description: Important: Correctly identifies that the time to pass through the tube is the difference t₂ − t₁.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: The final expression has correct dimensions of time (e.g., √(length/acceleration)).

title: Sign or conceptual error
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the answer incorrectly uses the length of the rod (a) instead of the cylinder length (b) in the displacement.

title: Algebraic mistake
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the expression for Δt is incorrectly derived, e.g., by subtracting under a single square root.
